pkgmetadata.longdescription: GSD Core (Git. Ship. Done.) is a meta-prompting, context-engineering and spec-driven development system for AI coding agents including Claude Code, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Codex and others. It drives agents through a disciplined discuss/plan/execute/verify/ship phase loop, running heavy work in fresh-context subagents to avoid context-window quality degradation. It is the open continuation of the now-deprecated get-shit-done-cc.
